messages:
maya: heads-up — saw a regression in paged-attn perf after we rolled fused-attn-v2 to staging. p95 spike on short queries.
jonathan: can you share numbers?
maya: quick numbers: baseline flash-alt p95=18ms (seq=64,batch=8), fused-attn-v2 p95=32ms. p50s close but tail doubled. CPU-side mallocs and page faults increased in the KV pager.
sandeep: any flamegraphs / perf samples?
maya: pasted a tiny snapshot: 
```
alloc: sparse_slab: bucket 32 -> 980 calls
kv_pager: page_faults 720 -> 2380
kernel_launch: fused_attn_v2 extra 1.6ms latency per launch
```
lucy: that smells like allocator fragmentation + page-fault amplification. our sparse-slab's freelist bins blow up with short-lived KV pages.
jonathan: hypothesis: fused-attn v2 increases small temporary buffers that interact badly with bucketed freelist; also kernel selector may be steering short seqs to fused-attn incorrectly.
maya: tried a quick config flip to hybrid_slab=true (hybrid slab + bucketed fallback). p95 dropped to 21ms, p50 ~unchanged. memory RSS +6% but alloc churn down ~60%.
sandeep: nice. what's the KV pager eviction behavior during the run?
maya: eviction rate increased ~30% under fused-attn; reclaim path invoked more frequently and caused synchronous CPU work.
jonathan: two action items: (1) fix kernel selector cost model to account for CPU alloc/pagefault costs, (2) experiment with compaction/scavenge epochs on the allocator.
lucy: agree. current selector rule is too simplistic. snippet: 
```
selector:
  if seq <= 64 and batch <= 8: prefer flash_alt
  if kv_paged: prefer paged_kv_kernel
  else: compare_est_costs
```
jonathan: problem: compare_est_costs only estimates GPU FLOPs + memory bandwidth; it ignores host-side page faults and allocator contention. we should augment with estimated CPU overhead = alpha * expected_page_faults_per_token.
maya: proposal: add telemetry hooks to compute per-run pagefaults and feed back into selector offline, then deploy a param update.
sandeep: also test prefetching KV pages for fused-attn path to reduce faults. could be a cheaper workaround.
lucy: for allocator: try bucketed-compaction with epoch scavenger and a hybrid-slab probe that biases small allocations to dense pages. add tag alloc_strategy=hybrid_probe.
maya: benchmarking plan: sweep seq=[16,32,64], batch=[1,4,8], kv_hit_ratio=[0.1,0.5,0.9]. record p50/p95/mem/alloc-churn/pagefaults.
maya: repro command I'm using:
```
./bench --model paged-attn --kernel auto --seq 64 --batch 8 --kv-pattern sparse --runs 1000 --tag alloc_strategy=hybrid_probe > /tmp/out.log
```
jonathan: also add a microbench for kernel-switch/fallback overhead (time to detect and fallback). target <0.8ms.
sandeep: I can wire a flamegraph pipeline to capture host vs GPU stacks for the failed runs.
lucy: add telemetry flag kernel_selector_debug=true to correlate chosen kernel + alloc metrics.
infra-bot: deploy v2.3.7-kv-pager rolling to staging succeeded :rocket:
maya: thanks infra-bot. I'll post the run results in ~2h and attach flamegraphs.
jonathan: one more note — if hybrid_slab increases RSS too much for Dedicated customers, add a runtime knob to prefer flash-alt path (GPU-bound) for dedicated without heavy KV paging.
maya: noted. pacing the experiments now. ping me if you want access to logs or to reproduce locally.
